name: Free Pascal
needs: Free Pascal 3.0 or newer (also fine for Lazarus projects) and nasm and ld (Linux x86-64) or as and ld (Linux ARM64)
notes: `Peep.pas` contains `{$linklib c}`. Free Pascal does not link libc by default, and without it a program that loads a shared library crashes inside the dynamic loader when it exits.
The unit is in `Peep.pas`; the class is `TPeep`.
`Read` returns at most 4096 frames per call.
files: demo: decodes the test files and prints checksums
